required.hint: AWS instance type (e.g. m5.large, t3.medium). Validated against EC2's instance-finder field.

traps: Use serviceCode 'ec2Enhancement' with templateId 'template'. The legacy (eC2Next, quickEstimate) format saves cleanly but renders Read-only — the calculator cannot rehydrate it. EstimateBuilder forces this transformation automatically; do not bypass it.

Reserved Instances (standard, convertible) are HIDDEN under shared tenancy. When you request model "reserved"/"standard" or "convertible" with shared tenancy, EstimateBuilder remaps to instanceSavings/computeSavings (the shared-tenancy equivalents) and emits a trace event. Real Standard/Convertible RIs require tenancy:"dedicated" or "host".

pricingStrategy values are validated at add_service: unresolvable models/terms/upfrontPayment are rejected with the valid values listed — nothing silently falls back to On-Demand. Accepted terms: '1 Year', '3 Year' (also '1yr'/'3yr', case-insensitive). Accepted upfrontPayment: 'None', 'Partial', 'All' (case-insensitive; 'No Upfront' style accepted).

The calculator silently demands tenancy, workload, workloadSelection, dataTransferForEC2, detailedMonitoringCheckbox, and ec2AdvancedPricingMetrics — even though the PCT does not mark them validations.required. EstimateBuilder injects all of these via lib/ec2.js#transformConfig.

utilization is HIDDEN inside the pricingStrategy component and does NOT appear in get_service_fields' field list. To set utilization, pass top-level utilization: 'N' (string, 1–100); EstimateBuilder routes it into pricingStrategy.value.utilizationValue.

workload is the INSTANCE COUNT — use it for the user's quantity. For 'two instances' set workload: 2 (one entry) or save two entries with workload: 1 each. Either is fine. Do NOT save workload: 1 for 'two instances' and stash the '2' only in description (the saved estimate prices for one instance and the user reads two). Do NOT compensate for utilization with workload (e.g. workload: 0.8 to fake 80% utilization) — the total cost may match but the saved estimate structurally lies about how many instances are running. Use the explicit utilization field instead.

The dataTransferForEC2 field is a composite widget. Its value must be an array of transfer entries, each with entryType, value, unit, and a region field. Valid entryTypes: INBOUND, OUTBOUND, INTRA_REGION.

OUTBOUND entries require a "toRegion" field — use "External" for internet or "other" for other AWS regions. INBOUND entries require a "fromRegion" field with the same options. INTRA_REGION requires neither.
All three entryTypes (INBOUND, OUTBOUND, INTRA_REGION) must be present in the array even if their value is "0".
